value.rationale: The result gives an exact oligomorphic profile for a directly studied omega-categorical homogeneous structure, identifies its finite tuple types with a standard combinatorial species, supplies a closed generating equation/Lambert-W form, and derives the complete repeated-coordinate profile by Stirling transform. This is a structural classification rather than a routine finite census.
